description: Canonical inventory of reusable instructions and runtime adapter imports.

fields.kind: map = describes repo/system structure (where things live, how discovery works); behavior = prescribes what an agent should do on a task
fields.trigger: always = applies to every task; otherwise a short description of the condition under which the instruction is relevant
fields.scopeGlobs: ordered glob list; the single source both Claude's `paths:` frontmatter and Copilot's `applyTo:` frontmatter are generated from. Present only for instructions with non-empty runtimeAdapters.
fields.copilotDescription: the one-line description rendered into Copilot's `description:` frontmatter. Claude's frontmatter has no description field and does not use this value. Present only for instructions with non-empty runtimeAdapters.

instructions.trigger: changes to the instruction/skill/routing system itself
instructions.copilotDescription: Use when changing instruction layering, agent roles, prompt artifacts, skills, hooks, or migration boundaries.

instructions.trigger: authoring or editing human-reviewed documentation or generated artifacts
instructions.copilotDescription: Formatting guidance for code-adjacent artifacts, docs, and agent-facing outputs.
Require a compact instruction-reference manifest for each completed prompt.
